item.subject: science
item.stem:
Ekta presses a rubber sucker onto a smooth steel cupboard. After she pushes air out from under the sucker, it stays firmly in place.

Why does the sucker stick?

options.A: The air pressure outside the sucker is greater than the air pressure under it, so the outside air presses it against the steel.
options.B: The atmospheric pressure outside sticks the sucker to the steel even when air was not pushed out from under it.
options.C: The air pressure under the sucker is greater than the air pressure outside, so the inside air presses it against the steel.
options.D: The sucker sticks even when the air pressure outside equals the air pressure under it.
